name: Qdrant
description: Rust vector search engine with HNSW and payload filtering, used for agent memory.
descriptionZh: 基于 HNSW 与载荷过滤的 Rust 向量检索引擎，可作 Agent 记忆层。
keyFact: Qdrant is an Apache-2.0 vector search engine written in Rust, founded in Berlin in 2021 by Andre Zayarni and Andrey Vasnetsov; it combines HNSW indexing with payload filtering and is offered as Qdrant Cloud, Hybrid and Private deployments.
keyFactZh: Qdrant 是用 Rust 编写的 Apache-2.0 向量检索引擎，2021 年由 Andre Zayarni 与 Andrey Vasnetsov 在柏林创立；它结合 HNSW 索引与载荷过滤，提供 Qdrant Cloud、Hybrid 与 Private 三种部署形态。
